stock.description: Operating as an investment holding company, China Boqi Environmental (Holding) Co., Ltd. delivers environmental protection solutions, with a primary focus on flue gas treatment services, across both the People's Republic of China and international territories. The company's operations are divided into four core business divisions: Environmental Protection Facility Engineering (EPC); Operation and Maintenance (O&M); Concession Operation; and a broader 'Others' category. The EPC segment is responsible for all stages of project development for coal-fired power plants, including engineering and design, procurement of necessary equipment and materials, construction, equipment installation, and final commissioning for systems that handle desulfurization, denitrification, and dust removal. The O&M segment is dedicated to ensuring the continuous and efficient functioning of desulfurization, denitrification, and dust removal facilities, providing services such as active operation, testing, repairs, system upgrades, and general upkeep of these flue gas treatment systems. Under the Concession Operation model, the company undertakes the construction or acquisition of infrastructure from a grantor, then operates and maintains the flue gas treatment project under a contractual concession arrangement, eventually transferring ownership of the infrastructure back to the grantor once the contract concludes. The 'Others' segment primarily involves the sale of by-products and other diverse activities. Furthermore, the company's activities extend to the sale of coal and chemicals, the provision of technology and exploration services, the treatment and disposal of hazardous and solid waste, and involvement in the water treatment industry. China Boqi Environmental (Holding) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2015 and has its corporate headquarters situated in Beijing, People's Republic of China.
